summary: Dyadic International filed an 8-K reporting entry into purchase agreements for a registered direct offering of 3,625,000 common shares at $0.795 per share and a concurrent private placement of warrants to purchase an equal number of shares at $0.84 exercise price, with gross proceeds of approximately $2.9 million. The offering is a routine capital raise under an existing shelf, not a special situation. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. No special-situation mechanics or risk-arb angle applies.
